status: Freeze exact four files publicly before opening retained predictions for this diagnostic
question: Where do existing background-labelled positive and saturated Hann scores lie relative to original annotation boundaries?
interpretation: Exploratory disagreement diagnosis on two already observed development fields; no true-ink adjudication, independent generalisation, label repair, method selection or promotion gate
sampling: Both complete unchanged fields from native_resolution/selection.json; no field or pixel replacement

inputs.secondary_use: Only already frozen cross-donor thresholds and aggregate counts; no secondary score arrays
inputs.source_label_cache: Existing primary source_cache objects indexed by SHA256 of canonical label URL; no downloads

geometry.distance: Euclidean distance between scoring-cell centres and original source-label centres, separately for labels 2 and 0; squared distances computed as integer coordinate differences after exact nearest-centre query
geometry.band_membership: Upper edge inclusive; distance exactly at an edge stays in the lower band; zero distance permitted by generic geometry but cannot join distinct source categories
geometry.halo_expansion_explanation: 76.8um radius plus one9.36um source-label-pixel guard, around the common-core outer cell boundaries; entire source-label rectangle mandatory
geometry.halo_policy: Abort if any required original label halo is outside the pinned canvas or unavailable; never fill or erase labels

support.eligible_background: Exactly primary common_support AND categorical label1; all such cells enter every denominator partition and original total
support.meaning: Saved common_support is the inherited all16-nonzero-fine-columns mask, not independent acquisition or physical-sheet validation
support.hole_distance: Euclidean distance to unsupported common-grid cell centres inside the original256x256 scoring core, using the same five physical bands
support.outside_core: Support outside the saved core mask is unobserved in this diagnostic; no CT is reread
support.censorship: Flag a cell if its centre lies at most76.8um from the outer continuous boundary of the scoring core; this affects interpretation only and excludes no cell
support.annotation_censorship: Both complete original-label halos are mandatory; known/unknown label distances within76.8um are not censored by the scoring crop
support.acquisition_provenance: Preserve primary complete-acquisition source receipt and input identities; do not recast nonzero-column masks as acquisition support

endpoints.own_float: Saved float_common Hann score > unchanged own-field float cutoff
endpoints.own_q8: Saved actual fine-export-derived uint8_common Hann score > unchanged own-field Q8 cutoff
endpoints.cross_float: Saved float_common Hann score > unchanged other-donor float cutoff
endpoints.cross_q8: Saved actual fine-export-derived uint8_common Hann score > unchanged other-donor Q8 cutoff
endpoints.float_ge_0_99: Saved float_common Hann score >=0.99, compared in float64
endpoints.q8_equal_one: Saved actual uint8_common Hann score ==1.0; no new quantisation

reporting.robust_interior: Distances to ink, unknown labels and observed support holes all >76.8um AND support distance not boundary-censored; other cells remain in censored or remaining categories
every_bin: share of all endpoint positives, null if endpoint total0
reporting.totals: All background-labelled positives, all supported ink positives at unchanged own/cross cutoffs, and old gate objects retained; bins must sum exactly to the same original background and positive totals
forbidden: new model selection or promotion gate
reporting.limits: A near-boundary concentration does not distinguish annotation error from model bleeding; far-interior disagreement does not adjudicate omitted ink, large geometry errors, wrong-sheet response or model artefact
reporting.model_exposure: Model-assisted public labels and previously used development donors; exact Hecate training/teacher exposure for these fields remains unresolved

limits.semantics: Whole run including imports/checks; SIGALRM plus checks, with native-call cleanup potentially delaying process exit; RSS is checked between bounded stages

fields.label_only_preflight: Existing categorical PNG hash/shape/encoding and whole-core mapping verified before prediction access; full282x282 source-label halo confirmed in bounds
